job: Show which companies use the product, as wordmarks in the text colour.
purpose: Customer wordmarks (inline SVG, in the text colour, never brand colours) as one quiet row after a lead-in sentence, a ruled grid, or a slow marquee. The marquee copies its list once (aria-hidden, inert), stops on hover, focus and its pause button, and is a wrapping row under reduced motion.
useWhen: Directly under the hero, as proof.

avoidWhen.when: Integrations or providers a user picks.
avoidWhen.instead: Use fd-tile in a list or grid.

states.name: paused
states.how: data-paused on the track, aria-pressed="true" on the pause button

variants.useWhen: Five or six logos on one quiet line.
Eight or more logos in ruled cells.
Many logos and little height; one marquee a page.

keyboard.does: On the pause button: stops or starts the strip.
